name: family-finance-template
description: Finance Tracker — Family Edition with Google Sheets and Mobile-First Apps Script PWA

scripts.sync: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('demo/assets',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('preview.html','demo/preview.html'); fs.copyFileSync('WebApp.html','demo/WebApp.html'); fs.copyFileSync('vercel.json','demo/vercel.json'); fs.copyFileSync('assets/tailwindcss.js','demo/assets/tailwindcss.js'); fs.copyFileSync('assets/og-cover.png','demo/assets/og-cover.png'); fs.copyFileSync('assets/logo-family.svg','demo/assets/logo-family.svg'); console.log('Demo assets synchronized to demo/');"
scripts.deploy:all: npm test && npm run sync && npm run deploy:gas && git add -A && git commit -m "deploy: automatic sync gas & web" && git push origin master
